summary_markdown: The session focused on debugging and resolving data inconsistencies observed on the analytics platform. Initial work was performed on a specific endpoint (Logreg). After deploying an `ml-api` hotfix, discrepancies were noted by someone regarding incorrect unique identifiers or values on the platform. Troubleshooting steps included checking cache and redeploying the `ml-api` main branch to the analytics environment. The issue was eventually resolved after further investigation, confirming that the data displayed was correct.
decisions: The `ml-api` main branch was re-deployed to the analytics platform.
